reason: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin that periodically retrieves OpenCode GO subscription usage and presents it in a collapsible corner widget with progress indicators and reset countdowns.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 页面中显示 OpenCode GO 套餐的滚动、每周和每月用量及重置倒计时，并支持自动刷新和折叠。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin that displays OpenCode GO rolling, weekly, and monthly usage with reset countdowns, automatic refresh, and a collapsible corner widget.

capabilities: Reads an OpenCode API key from a local authentication file
Invokes PowerShell on Windows to fetch usage data
Displays rolling, weekly, and monthly usage percentages with reset countdowns in a web widget
